INFO.name: QUERY
INFO.value: SELECT DISTINCT proposal_id,member_ous_uid,asdm_uid,target_name,science_observation,is_mosaic FROM ivoa.obscore WHERE science_observation='T' AND (1=INTERSECTS(CIRCLE('ICRS',11.887184566666667,-25.288874822222223,0.00027777777777777778),s_region) OR 1=INTERSECTS(CIRCLE('ICRS',11.887768008333332,-25.288411111111113,0.00027777777777777778),s_region) OR 1=INTERSECTS(CIRCLE('ICRS',11.888351445833333,-25.2879474,0.00027777777777777778),s_region))

FIELD.name: proposal_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Identifier of proposal to which NO observation belongs.

FIELD.name: asdm_uid
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: UID of the ASDM containing this Field.

FIELD.name: science_observation
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Flag to indicate whether this is a science observation.

FIELD.name: is_mosaic
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Flag to indicate if this ASDM represents a mosaic or not.
